title: fix(components): element:repeater reads its query from dataSource alone (objectui#12345)
body:
Fixes #12345
Clause-②: no

## What

`element:repeater` now reads its query from the node-level `dataSource` binding alone. `@objectstack/spec` 18 retired the row's flat `object` / `filter` / `sort` / `limit` (objectstack#11509, ruling A-narrow), and objectui#12030's types mirror already refuses them. This PR does the card's two steps in order, with no grace window and no second spelling:

1. **Producer first.** `apps/console/src/dev/DevLists.tsx` (the console dev route, the last in-repo producer) now writes `dataSource: { object: 'showcase_category', limit: 10 }`. Both of its nodes are typed `DeclaredNode` literals instead of `as any` casts. The cast is how the flat keys got past the types mirror, so the authoring face now checks them.
2. **Then the reads.** In `RepeaterRenderer` (`packages/components/src/renderers/basic/data-list.tsx`), the fallback reads of the four retired keys are deleted, along with the flat/binding filter merge that existed only to AND a flat filter in, the module-local `isUsableRowLimit` copy, and the comments that described the fallback.

Per read, measured against `useElementDataSource` and `composeElementDataSource` (`@object-ui/core`):

| read deleted | what it was |
|---|---|
| `props.object` (in `composed?.object ?? props.object`) | the retired flat `object`, from `readProps` (the `properties` bag, or the legacy `props` alias) |
| `props.filter` (the `scoped` merge, its `toFilterNodeSafely` lowering and its refusal panel) | the retired flat `filter` |
| `props.sort` (in `config?.sort ?? props.sort ?? composed?.sort`) | the retired flat `sort` |
| `props.limit`, twice (the middle arm and the trailing `?? props.limit`) | the retired flat `limit`. No other `limit` channel exists here: `config.limit` is the binding's own cap and `composed.limit` is the binding/view composition |

What is kept is exactly the binding arm of each old chain. `composed.sort` is already `config.sort ?? view.sort`, and `composed.limit` is already the binding's usable cap, else the view's. So `sort = composed?.sort` and `limit = composed?.limit` give a binding-bound repeater the same read it had before.

## Producer search (A2)

Run on this branch's base (`2312bd9`): `git grep` for `element:repeater` nodes (TS and JSON spellings, excluding CHANGELOGs and `.changeset/`), with any `object` / `filter` / `sort` / `limit` key in the ten lines after the type. Hits: `DevLists.tsx` (the producer, moved here) and the `content/docs/guide/data-source.md` JSON example, which already writes the canonical `dataSource` shape and is not a producer. The Studio inspector (`block-config.ts`) already writes `at: 'dataSource'` (objectui#12056). The test fixtures that used the flat spelling only to name the object are listed under Pins.

**Correction (seat, after patch round 2 at `9aa111e`):** the search above was incomplete. It anchored on a `type: 'element:repeater'` literal and the ten lines after it, so it missed a second, test-only producer: the `componentsTarget('element:repeater', …)` fixture in `packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/widget-dom-leak-sweep.test.tsx`, which CI shard 9 caught. That fixture now writes `dataSource`. A wider re-grep (any spelling, six lines either side, with a control that fires on both known producers at base) finds no producer left at the branch tip. Its remaining hits are negative pins, binding literals and the inspector's stale-key pins, listed in the dev report `6167117435` on objectui#12345.

## Surface beyond the expected two files, and why

- `packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/widget-dom-leak-sweep.test.tsx`: the `element:repeater` sweep fixture moved onto `dataSource` (patch round, `9aa111e`). It named its object through the retired flat key, so the repeater no longer reached its canary.
- `content/docs/guide/data-source.md`: the repeater paragraph and its table row described the fallback read and the flat-filter AND. Both became false with this change, so they are rewritten.
- `packages/types/src/zod/public-blocks.zod.ts`: comment only. The `ElementRepeaterBlockSchema` docblock said the renderer "still reads a stored document's flat keys as a fallback". No type or schema change.
- `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`: comment only, the same false sentence.

## Pins

- `data-list.elementDataSource-11880.test.tsx`, rewritten. The cases that pinned the fallback branch are replaced: flat keys alone, in the `properties` bag and in the `props` bag, issue no read and show the empty state; beside a binding they change nothing (the exact query is the binding's); a binding with no query keys of its own borrows none; a binding that names no object issues no read; a bound control does read. The saved-view precedence cases now run on binding-only nodes.
- New `apps/console/src/__tests__/DevLists.repeaterBinding-12345.test.tsx`: the dev route renders both primitives, and its repeater reads `('showcase_category', { $top: 10 })`.
- Respelled onto `dataSource` (they used the flat spelling only to name the object, sort or filter): `data-list.sortKey-10664`, `data-list.contractEnvelope-6726`, `elementReaders.invalidationRefetch-10623`, `components/src/__tests__/data-list.test.tsx`, and the repeater row of the console's `filterContextTokensSweep-10666`.
- Types and spec refusal of a flat key: already pinned, by name on both zod faces and on the TS face held to the installed row, in `packages/types/src/__tests__/element-repeater-data-source-11880.test.ts`. That file is unchanged and green here.

## Evidence (at `9f66f17` unless noted)

- Ablation, committed first and then mutated through `ablation-replace`, which checks the anchor and blob: re-adding `?? schema.properties.object` to the object read turns 2 new pins red (`flat keys ... in properties`, `a binding that names no object`). After restore the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty. Tests alias `@object-ui/components` to `src`, so no dist rebuild was involved.
- Reverse verification on the producer: adding `object: 'showcase_category'` to `DevLists`' `properties` gives `TS2322 ... "[REMOVED] Key retired ..."`, then the file is restored to HEAD. This ran on a narrowed compile (a temporary tsconfig extending the console's, including only `src/dev/DevLists.tsx`; `--listFilesOnly` confirms the file is in it; the clean control exits 0), because the shared verify lock was held by a sibling run.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check`: exit 0 (at `b9919ac`; components are unchanged since). `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check`: exit 0.
- Targeted vitest (at `b9919ac`; the next commit only drops an unused import): 10 files, 410 tests passed. The files are the six components repeater files above, the types repeater pin, the new DevLists pin, `filterContextTokensSweep-10666`, and `registry-inputs-spec-parity`.
- Lint narrowed to the 11 changed TS/TSX files (`eslint --no-inline-config --format json`): 11 files, 0 errors. `eslint.config.js` declares no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so the lint is not type-aware and this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file.
- Gates, exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `new-line-citations`, and `check-changeset-fixed` / `-presence` / `-no-major`. `check:spec-floors` exits 1 with "The scan collapsed: 0 package(s) declare @objectstack/spec", the known main-side failure (objectui#12334). It is recorded, not fixed.
- Full components suite (`pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/`, at `9f66f17`): 383 files passed, 1 skipped; 3891 tests passed, 24 skipped. The full console project is declared to CI. Its repeater-related files are in the targeted run above.

## Clause-②

No published export or accept set moves. The `@object-ui/types` schemas and TS face already refused the four keys before this PR. The repeater registration's `inputs` are unchanged (objectui#12085 already dropped the flat ones). `isUsableRowLimit` was module-local. What does narrow is runtime behaviour: a stored node that was never converted and carries only flat keys now lists nothing. The changeset marks `@object-ui/components` as `minor` and says so.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/types/src/zod/README.md` still says the number and repeater arms "mirror the spec gate's one waiver: their bag may omit `object` when `dataSource.object` names the object". That waiver ended with spec 18 (objectui#12030), before this PR. It is doc drift that this change neither caused nor touches. Carrier: none.
